newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 880,000 barrels in the week ended June 13 to 323.08 million barrels from 323.96 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.73 million barrels in the week to 257.71 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 3.29 million barrels to 112.54 million barrels from 109.25 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 383,000 barrels to 37.41 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 254,000 barrels in the week to 8.23 million bpd from 7.98 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 1.68 million barrels in the week to 204.12 million barrels from 202.44 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 97.6 percent from 98.3 percent the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 3.01 million barrels to 42.49 million barrels from 39.48 million barrels the previous week.
API also said crude runs refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 fell to 96.5 percent in the week from 98.6 percent the previous week.
API said total crude runs to processing units fell to 15.08 million barrels per day from 15.17 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 39.62 million barrels from 40.93 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 9.39 million barrels per day from 8.43 million, API said.
